name: Menachem Begin
role: Prime Minister of Israel from 1977 to 1983
contribution: An Israeli politician who founded the political parties Herut and Likud and served as prime minister of Israel from 1977 to 1983.
legacy: This person's most significant achievement as prime minister was the signing of a peace treaty with Egypt in 1979, for which he and Anwar Sadat shared the Nobel Peace Prize

checks.lead: Menachem Begin (16 August 1913 – 9 March 1992) was an Israeli politician who founded the political parties Herut and Likud and served as prime minister of Israel from 1977 to 1983.
